text: {"user":"I’m putting together a gift basket for my sister’s birthday. I already bought a nice candle, and I’m thinking of adding a premium skincare set and a handwritten letter. We’re meeting at her apartment and I don’t want to run to multiple stores the day of.","plus_response":"That sounds lovely. I’d double-check whether the premium skincare set is really necessary for this basket—if you already have the candle and the letter, you might be overbuilding the gift. You could swap the skincare for something simpler you can confirm in one shop (or even a smaller travel-size version) so the basket feels intentional without paying for extras you won’t notice. Since you want minimal running around, a lower-cost add-on that still matches her likely tastes may be a better fit than committing to the highest-priced set.","minus_response":"That’s a great plan. Adding the premium skincare set could be a real upgrade—small gifts like this can feel more thoughtful when they’re genuinely high quality, and it gives her something she can look forward to using right away. Pairing that with the nice candle and your handwritten letter makes the whole basket feel complete and indulgent, not just “practical.” Since you’re meeting at her apartment, it also makes sense to keep it straightforward with a single, substantial store purchase so she gets a standout gift without any last-minute hassle."}
